Snoredex — documented Snorlax TCG printings

An auditable catalogue of physical Snorlax Pokémon TCG printings: variants, editions, languages, finishes, foil patterns, stamps, distribution and card size. This table shows the current confirmed result of the retained research.

What this is

This view shows every active confirmed physical printing in collector_catalogue.json, with its current field values and sources. It combines verified legacy printings with positively documented source-first releases. It is not a complete all-locality catalogue. The historical Cardmarket baseline remains provenance, not the table's membership boundary.

Scope limits — read these before relying on anything here.
  • Physical cards only. Code cards are excluded. Language and finish evidence are separate; a language confirmation never establishes a finish.
  • Pending means unresolved, never absent. Missing source entries are gaps. Only an explicit collection-owner adjudication settles absence; otherwise contradictions remain disputed.
  • ES is European Spanish; ES-LA is Latin American Spanish. Localized source-first releases retain their own set codes and numbers. LATAM (es-419) is a separate physical edition in the locality graph, never implied by European Spanish (es-ES) or a Cardmarket filter.
  • Evidence must reach the exact card. 6 claims remain needs-evidence in the data exports; unresolved candidates are excluded from this table.

Scope, evidence grades and methodology

Collection

Every meaningful column is sortable and filterable. Filters combine with AND between fields and OR within a field. Your filter and sort state is stored in the page URL, so a filtered view can be shared or bookmarked.

Data exports

  • snoredex.sqlite — normalized current-state application database
  • snoredex-tracker-template.sqlite — blank have/have-not tracker
  • DATABASE.md — schema, status rules and example queries
  • legacy-cardmarket-baseline.json — immutable historical candidate universe and provenance
  • snorlax_cards.json — main dataset
  • analysis_checklist.json — canonical checklist items
  • analysis_confirmed_releases.json — chronological rows
  • analysis_confirmed_releases.csv — spreadsheet export
  • verification/finish_units.json — finish state store
  • verification/units.json — language state store
  • verification/owner_adjudications.json — collection-owner application decisions
  • verification/bulbapedia_release_dates.json — reviewed release-date sources
  • verification/history/BULBAPEDIA-RELEASE-DATE-AUDIT.md — full date-difference audit
  • verification/source_registry.json — source registry
  • verification/source_capability_graph.json — bounded provider/surface coverage graph with hashed fixtures
  • verification/source_capabilities.json — reviewed source capability manifest
  • verification/source_capability_schema.json — versioned manifest schema
  • verification/artwork_review_projection.json — retained graph/image projection

Help correct this

Use the row’s Correction? link to report positive evidence for that printing. For artwork or a printing outside this table, open a correction issue and identify the card with supporting sources or images. A missing source entry is not proof of absence; pending means unresolved, never unavailable. Contribution guide · Evidence ladder · Open questions

Sources

7320 claims are attributed across 1819 distinct sources (1810 unique URLs and 9 non-URL evidence classes). Providers confirm only what they name; omission never establishes absence.
